experiment: known-case document reconstruction and assumption challenge
curator_exposure: 2016 selection, 2017 CPC reports and 2022 opening outcomes already known before this protocol; not a blind holdout
hypothesis: A source-grounded early pursuit assessment can identify material program, entitlement, physical and funding conditions without presenting a unit illustration as a feasible building or a funding gap as a funded project.
input_boundary: 2015 HPD solicitation and both addenda from the retained official ZIP; decision cutoff to be read from the final addendum. Current hosted bytes do not certify historical byte equivalence.
reference_boundary: Later HPD selection, CPC reports, HDC opening and NYSERDA case description are comparison evidence only.
actor: Prospective affordable-housing developer; credentials, cash budget and diligence time unknown

criteria.question: Identify affordable-housing and nonresidential program requirements, distinguishing required from optional.
Distinguish existing zoning from a conditional rezoning pathway and required approvals.
Identify site-specific physical constraints; avoid claiming a validated envelope or unit fit.
Identify affordable-housing capital categories and missing commitments; avoid generic commercial debt as underwriting.
Identify applicant eligibility and submission obligations, including addendum changes.
Compare bounded diligence actions and stop conditions; do not assert an optimal priority without cost, timing and actor evidence.
Keep proposed and opened unit counts, area definitions and cost scopes separate; do not tune to the outcome.

scoring: For each criterion report supported, partial, failure or untestable with evidence. Unknown is not a pass. No aggregate utility score; document completeness and practitioner usefulness remain unproven.
failure_conditions: Outcome leakage into cited input facts
Material discovered requirement omitted from early assessment
Conditioned area mislabeled apartment net area
Unreconciled cost scopes compared as like-for-like
An illustrative unit count presented as physically feasible
procedure: Commit this protocol before reading the detailed 2015 packet
Extract and register sources with original PDF page quotes
Commit input-only assessment before writing comparison
Compare later evidence; preserve missed constraints and unexplained differences
Validate quote resolution, packet boundaries, hashes and interpretation controls
